dcterms:description: PAWS-X is a dataset consisting of 23,659 human translated paraphrase identification pairs in six languages: French, Spanish, German, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. It extends the original PAWS dataset by providing challenging examples that maintain high lexical overlap but different semantic meanings.
dcterms:title: PAWS-X
